name: ON AIR
source:
Hero gets a part-time job at a television station. It's a very rigorous job and he's yelled by the boss all the time. However, with time he becomes friends with five female casters, each with her own goals, and he gets motivated to learn more about the place and its workers.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄在一家电视台找到了一份兼职工作。这是一项非常严格的工作，他总是被老板吼叫。然而，随着时间的推移，他与五名女解说成为了朋友，每个解说都有自己的目标，他有动力更多地了解这个地方及其工作人员。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
